en.html:
Finally, a warrior calling himself <ruby>Kuronose Douji<rt>Kuronose Douji</rt></ruby>. Apparently a leader in a faction opposing the Rokuhara shogunate. Kageaki and I had saved him after his intrusion into Chachamaru’s manor went wrong. He had returned and this time saved me.

He alone apparently knew nothing of Silver Star. My account had considerably bewildered him. Behind his mask, he silently digested it.

ja.html:
最後に、<ruby>黒瀬童子<rt>くろのせどうじ</rt></ruby>と称する武人。
　どうも六波羅幕府に敵対する一勢力の頭目のような
立場らしい。茶々丸の館に忍び込んで窮したところを
景明と私に救われ、再びやって来て今度は私を救った。

　彼だけは銀星号について何も知らなかったらしく、
私の話を聞いてだいぶん困惑した様子を見せている。
　覆面の中で押し黙り、情報を咀嚼するふうだった。

en.html:
舞殿宮"...Well. That is a surprise..."
舞殿宮"So much surprise, I cannot select where to begin. Eh, Chief?"
Chief"...Yes."
舞殿宮"This young lady being Muramasa armor, I had heard from the Chief, so let us put that aside. Though really it does not fit aside at all."
舞殿宮"Kageaki has been brainwashed by Silver Star and gone over to the shogunate?"
Muramasa"..."
Sayo"From this account, however, Lady Chachamaru and Rokuhara cannot necessarily be treated as the same party."
Kanae"Quite. Rather than the shogunate, the Lord of Horigoe is connected to Silver Star, and has now drawn Kageaki into her circle also."
Ichijou"What the hell is she planning?"
Sayo"Well now... some great undertaking in cooperation with Silver Star, apparently."
Kanae"Not merely using it in a struggle for power within the shogunate, or in a war with the occupation forces. Something more... alien to those concerns."
Chief"Indeed. The other three lords—Doushin Yusa, Raichou Imagawa, Shishiku Ootori—certainly possess ambitions of their own."
Chief"But their ambitions depend first on Rokuhara’s foundations. That permits them to unite against an outside enemy. Chachamaru Ashikaga, however—"
舞殿宮"Something different at that foundation, no?"
Chief"Yes."
Kanae"..."
Sayo"..."
黒瀬"..."

舞殿宮 「この姉ちゃんが村正の劒冑ってのは、ま、 署長から聞いてたからええとしといて。 　……ほんとはちっとも良くないけどなぁ」

香奈枝 「そうですね。 　幕府ではなく堀越公方が銀星号と繋がって いて、今は景明さまをも取り込んでいる…… と考えるべきでしょう」

さよ 「…………」

What did she truly want?

en.html:
His Highness and the Chief summarized events since the sword offering. Hachimangu had <ruby>disappeared<rt>・・・</rt></ruby> through Silver Star’s power, so His Highness had moved to Kenchouji.

Despite its close ties to the Ashikaga clan controlling the shogunate, Kenchouji secretly contained many monks sympathetic to the imperial court. His Highness’s group could therefore act more freely than before.

One result was contact with survivors of the Okabe clan, destroyed after rebelling against the shogunate. Their leader was Kuronose Douji, sitting here.

ja.html:
宮様は署長と一緒に、奉刀参拝から今までのことを
かいつまんで説明してくれた。
　八幡宮が銀星号によって<ruby>消えて<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>しまったので、宮様
の居はこの建朝寺に移されたこと……。

　建朝寺は幕府を牛耳る足利一門と縁深いが、それで
いて朝廷に心を寄せる僧も実は密かに多いため、宮様
を中心とする一派は以前より活発な行動がとれるよう
になったこと……。

　その成果の一つが、幕府に反逆して滅ぼされた岡部
一族の残党との接触であり、彼らをまとめているのが
ここにいる黒瀬童子であること……。

舞殿宮"Wait? Kikuchi—"
Kanae"...Well, being used does suggest he is not in immediate danger of being killed."
Sayo"Depending, of course, on what use is intended."
Chief"The Lord of Horigoe’s designs are troubling, but we must not forget the shogunate as a whole. That is the more immediate concern."
Chief"The shogunate seeks an imperial appointment of Kuniuji Ashikaga as Lord General. If it succeeds, Yamato will probably reach a decisive turning point."
Kanae"...Yes. There is scarcely any doubt that GHQ is planning military action to coincide with it."
Sayo"They appear to have prepared a decisive new weapon."
Chief"Rokuhara and the occupation forces. Neither victory is desirable to us."
Chief"Nor, naturally, an inconclusive war that merely exhausts our land and people."
黒瀬"...They must not be allowed to fight now. Therefore Shirou Ashikaga’s appointment must be obstructed?"
Chief"Correct."
舞殿宮"We are in touch with Kyoto, asking them to stretch it out somehow. How long they can manage, nobody knows."
Chief"Not long, I should think. While we have time, we must work upon the shogunate’s ministers—"
Muramasa"..."
en.text:
舞殿宮"Wait? Kikuchi—"
Kanae"...Well, being used does suggest he is not in immediate danger of being killed."
Sayo"Depending, of course, on what use is intended."
Chief"The Lord of Horigoe’s designs are troubling, but we must not forget the shogunate as a whole. That is the more immediate concern."
Chief"The shogunate seeks an imperial appointment of Kuniuji Ashikaga as Lord General. If it succeeds, Yamato will probably reach a decisive turning point."
Kanae"...Yes. There is scarcely any doubt that GHQ is planning military action to coincide with it."
Sayo"They appear to have prepared a decisive new weapon."
Chief"Rokuhara and the occupation forces. Neither victory is desirable to us."
Chief"Nor, naturally, an inconclusive war that merely exhausts our land and people."
黒瀬"...They must not be allowed to fight now. Therefore Shirou Ashikaga’s appointment must be obstructed?"
Chief"Correct."
舞殿宮"We are in touch with Kyoto, asking them to stretch it out somehow. How long they can manage, nobody knows."
Chief"Not long, I should think. While we have time, we must work upon the shogunate’s ministers—"
Muramasa"..."

ja.html:
舞殿宮 「後回しって、菊池ぃ」
香奈枝 「……まぁ……利用されているということは 差し当たって命を奪われる危険はないという ことでもありますけれど」
さよ 「何にどう利用されるのかにもよりますなァ」
署長 「堀越公方の目論見も気掛かりですが、幕府 全体の動きも忘れてはなりません。 　今はこちらの方が差し迫っています」
署長 「幕府が朝廷に働き掛けている、足利邦氏へ の大将領宣下……。 　これが成功した時、おそらく大和の情勢は 決定的な節目を迎えます」
香奈枝 「……ええ。 　その時機に合わせて、ＧＨＱが軍事行動を 企画しているのはほぼ疑いありません」
さよ 「決定力となる新兵器が用意されている模様 でございます」
署長 「六波羅と進駐軍。 　我々としてはどちらの勝利も望ましくない」
署長 「無論、両者の戦争が決着せず、いたずらに 国土と国民を疲弊させてゆくのも」
黒瀬 「……今は両者を争わせるべきではない。 　従って、足利四郎への大将領宣下を妨害し なくてはならぬ、ということか」
署長 「そうです」
舞殿宮 「京都と連絡を取り合って、何とかかんとか 引き伸ばしてもろうてるけどなァ……。 　いつまで続けられるかはわからんねえ」
署長 「長くはもたないでしょう。 　今のうちに幕閣内への工作を進め――」
村正 「…………」
